title: Replace the Shirt with Striped Front-Shell Coloration
objective: Delete the separate Shirt/ring construction and make 3–5 bold front-to-rear burglar stripes part of the thorax/front exoskeleton surface while preserving the dark rear abdomen and all accepted character/gameplay behavior.
acceptance: Body/Shirt and all separate shirt base, tubular ring, and floating stripe geometry are completely absent
the stable Thorax/front shell itself carries either a deterministic Z-driven striped ShaderMaterial or 3–5 joined non-cylinder ShellStripe pieces that replace the underlying thorax surface
shader stripes use local VERTEX.z, expose contrasting stripe_light and stripe_dark plus stripe_count 3–5, remain static and matte, and cross the shell left-to-right while progressing front-to-rear
any geometry fallback has no underlying intact thorax mesh, no gaps or garment thickness, common-height Z-distributed segments, and no cylinders
the visual sequence remains dark integrated Head/Mask, striped Thorax/front shell, and a separately dark unstriped rear Abdomen
integrated emissive eyes, mask, antennae, six articulated Upper/Lower legs, squat low-poly beetle silhouette, and front/rear segmentation remain readable
TB-R03A gait/body articulation, TB-R01 movement, collision, camera, interaction, gameplay loop, and all three levels remain unchanged
TB-001 through TB-R03A regressions with TB-H01 stabilization, preserved TB-R04 face identity, mandatory top/side/gameplay renders, Linux export, and all exported levels pass
only scenes/player.tscn and, if strictly necessary, scripts/player.gd change; no external asset, level, locomotion, animation, audio, or gameplay work is included
